name: Ink Business Cash Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 12 months from account opening on purchases. After that, 16.74% Min. of (6.75+9.99) and 29.99% to 24.74% Min. of (6.75+17.99) and 29.99% variable APR.

fx_fee.notes: Not stated on product page. Preserved as null — not re-verified.

rewards.currency_label: Cash Back rewards (tracked as points; each $1 in Cash Back = 100 points)

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other purchases with no limit to the amount you can earn.

categories.label: Office supply stores and internet, cable and phone services (combined)

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem for cash back as a statement credit, direct deposit to most U.S. checking and savings accounts, travel through Chase Travel, Apple Ultimate Rewards Store, or gift cards. No minimums to redeem.

signup_bonus.description: Earn $750 cash back after you spend $8,000 on purchases in the first 4 months after account opening.

benefits.title: Complimentary three month Instacart+ membership
benefits.description: Enroll in complimentary three-month Instacart+ membership (auto renews at $99/year after complimentary period). Plus, once activated, Instacart+ members get a $20 Instacart credit each month automatically loaded into their Instacart Business Account.

benefits.title: Employee cards at no additional cost
benefits.description: Employee cards let you set individual spending limits and help you earn rewards even faster.

benefits.title: Automatic credit line increase checks
benefits.description: As a Chase cardmember, you'll be automatically checked for a credit line increase every 6 months or sooner.

benefits.title: Chase Pay Over Time
benefits.description: Break up credit card purchases into budget friendly payments. After purchase: pay off eligible purchases of $100 or more in smaller equal monthly payments. No interest, just a fixed monthly fee.

notes: Verified from official Chase product page.
